question: Find a single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 20%, 4% and 14%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount for x% and y% is (x + y − xy/100)%.

For 20% and 4% ⇒ 20 + 4 − (20 × 4)/100 = 24 − 0.8 = 23.2%

For 23.2% and 14% ⇒ 23.2 + 14 − (23.2 × 14)/100 = 37.2 − 3.248 = 33.952%

The total approximate discount is 33.95%.

**∴ The correct answer is 33.95%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three consecutive discounts = 20%, 4%, and 14%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100) × (1 − D₃/100)
